chars.H: HUSBAND: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark grey jogging trousers, white sneakers.
chars.W: WIFE: a young woman wearing a burgundy headscarf and a long cream knitted cardigan over a navy blue dress.
chars.S: SISTER: an older woman wearing a bright teal blouse, big gold hoop earrings and black wide trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modern Casablanca apartment living room, HUSBAND (face visible, head-to-waist, sneaky worried expression) quietly picks up a smartphone from a side table, glancing over his shoulder; in the background through an open kitchen doorway WIFE stands at the stove with her back turned, cooking. Seen from the hallway.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot: HUSBAND sitting on a sofa in a Casablanca living room, holding the smartphone with both hands, typing on it with his thumb, eyebrows raised, confident sly look. The phone screen faces away from the viewer.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND leaning forward on the sofa, staring at the smartphone screen glow on his face, curious, scrolling with one thumb. Cozy Moroccan living room with a patterned rug and cushions, morning light from a window.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND on the sofa, smiling amused at the phone; behind him on the wall a framed picture of a small clothing boutique with clothes racks. Calm morning light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND yawning, tired eyes, sitting on the edge of a bed in a Moroccan bedroom with the phone in his hand, a security guard vest hanging on a chair, early morning light through curtains.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan apartment kitchen: WIFE stirring a pot of tagine on the stove, humming, relaxed, facing the stove; through the doorway behind her HUSBAND is on the living room sofa hunched over the phone, nervous, glancing toward the kitchen.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND frozen on the sofa holding the phone close to his face, eyes wide in shock, mouth open, one hand on his forehead. Dramatic, the living room slightly darker, the phone glow lighting his face.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Flashback in the same Casablanca apartment: SISTER (face visible) sits close to WIFE on the living room sofa, both drinking mint tea from small glasses, SISTER whispering something into WIFE's ear with a sly smile, WIFE listening. Warm afternoon light.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND standing up from the sofa holding the phone at arm's length, staring at it in disbelief and suspicion, frowning hard, tense; the kitchen doorway behind him with steam coming out.
